newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland Communications in $100 mln U.S. note issue.
newsitem.headline: Poland Communications in $100 mln U.S. note issue.

text.p: Poland Communications Inc, which controls cable TV operator Polska Telewizja Kablowa (PTK), has signed an agreement with Merrill Lynch on a $100 million senior note offering, Gazeta Wyborcza reported on Saturday.
The newspaper quoted PTK executive director Andrzej Muras as saying the sale of the paper, due in 2003, will begin on the U.S. market next week.
Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co (DCR) has assigned a BB- rating to the offering.
PTK is Poland's largest cable operator, with around half a million subscribers in six clusters including the cities of Gdansk, Warsaw, Lublin, Szczecin, Katowice and Krakow.

It will use the proceeds of the offering to invest in its network and planned to provide internet and multimedia services, Muras said, adding that if the issue went well the firm would consider another.
